connector.name: marginal
connector.registryDescription: Email A/B tests for AI agents: subject lines, managed sends, open/click tracking, and results.
connector.summary: Hosted at marginal.sh over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace sh.marginal, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.description: Bearer token with your marginal API key from https://marginal.sh/dashboard
